concurrency.answer: backend/src/servers/scheduler/task_dispatcher.py checks profile.max_concurrent_sessions (min 1) before starting a task session; Free plan also limits remote machines to one (pricing).

queues.answer: Task dispatches sit in a queued row ('queued: N of M sessions busy') claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, retried every 5 seconds when the profile is busy and every 60 seconds when the machine is offline; a dispatching row stuck over 5 minutes is failed visibly.

backpressure.answer: A profile at its session cap defers new task dispatches rather than starting more sessions; no host CPU or memory based backpressure.

limitations: No resource scheduling.

changes.summary: Independent review corrections at commit c5d8d97. RUN-08: the task dispatcher (backend/src/servers/scheduler/task_dispatcher.py) enforces a per-agent-profile max_concurrent_sessions cap, shows 'queued: N of M sessions busy', re-checks busy profiles every 5 seconds and offline machines every 60 seconds, and claims rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; the claim said there was no queue and no session cap, so concurrency, queues and backpressure are corrected and the answer reworded. COORD-01 quotas and COORD-02 claims/queues now cite the same cap and atomic dispatch claim. COORD-04 retries: automations advance next_run_at inside the claim transaction and record fired, missed_offline or failed in last_run_status, with no retry (was unknown). ACC-05 stability: bounded search of README, SELF_HOSTING.md and docs/*.mdx found no API stability or deprecation policy (was unknown).

RUN-08.answer: Machine count limits on the Free plan; no queue, CPU/RAM awareness or check deduplication; tasks Queued until an agent starts.

concurrency.answer: Free plan one remote machine; no session cap documented.

quotas.answer: Free: 1 remote machine, 10 automations; Pro unlimited.

claims.answer: Assignee is whose turn it is; each agent works one task in one session.

RUN-08.answer: Per-agent-profile concurrent-session cap in the task dispatcher with a visible queued state ('queued: N of M sessions busy') and periodic re-check (5 seconds busy, 60 seconds offline machine); Free plan limits remote machines to one; no CPU/RAM awareness, check deduplication or fairness policy.

concurrency.answer: backend/src/servers/scheduler/task_dispatcher.py checks profile.max_concurrent_sessions (min 1) before starting a task session; Free plan also limits remote machines to one (pricing).

queues.answer: Task dispatches sit in a queued row ('queued: N of M sessions busy') claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, retried every 5 seconds when the profile is busy and every 60 seconds when the machine is offline; a dispatching row stuck over 5 minutes is failed visibly.

backpressure.answer: A profile at its session cap defers new task dispatches rather than starting more sessions; no host CPU or memory based backpressure.

quotas.answer: Free: 1 remote machine and 10 automations; Pro unlimited machines (pricing); each agent profile has a max_concurrent_sessions cap enforced by the task dispatcher (backend/src/servers/scheduler/task_dispatcher.py).

claims.answer: Task dispatch rows are claimed atomically (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) and one session exists per (profile, task); assignment of the task itself is whose-turn semantics rather than an exclusive lock.

retries.answer: backend/src/servers/scheduler/loop.py advances next_run_at inside the claim transaction and dispatch.py records fired, missed_offline or failed in last_run_status; a failed or missed run is not retried, the next scheduled occurrence runs.

stability.answer: Searched README.md, SELF_HOSTING.md and apps/web/content/docs/*.mdx: no API stability, versioning or deprecation policy is documented.
